text: The mandatory runtime shall bind each required private entry to its same-spelled aux definition with token `<contracts-id>#<entry-name>` and exact raw carriers/default packet ABI. `bootstrap`, `initialize`, `dispatch`, `request_exit`, `drain_callbacks`, and `fault` shall always exist; operation-dependent entries/helper specializations shall close. Contract `never` shall imply no result entries and nonreturning behavior.
